Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal asked me to kick off the processing agreement so we can align on the signatory path and a couple of carveouts before our SSO and onboarding kickoff.  Two items at the top of our list:

- Data retention: we're seeing a default 24-month retention in Redwood's template; need confirmation whether a 6-month retention carveout for aggregated telemetry is acceptable to Redwood.
- SCCs & export: we operate primarily in the US but need clear mapping for SCCs and any subprocessor list.

Attached is our standard DPA (CareGrid_DPA_v2.pdf) with a couple of in-line notes. Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the counterparty signer (name/title) and the expected timeline for returning a redline? We are aiming for an executed DPA by 10/18 so provisioning can start the week of 10/22.

Thanks,

Marta

Ben / team — attaching our redline and a short summary of open items. I focused on the retention paragraph, SCCs, and subprocessors.

Key comments (summary):
- Retention: Redwood can accept a 6-month retention carveout for aggregated telemetry only, provided customer confirms no regulated PHI in those telemetry events. If PHI present, retention remains 24 months unless HIPAA-compliant BAAs are in place.
- SCCs: we will append the standard EU SCCs where applicable; please confirm whether CareGrid requires EU SoA (they appear US-based but ask for SCC mapping).
- Subprocessors: listed in the evidence matrix; if customer requests specific subprocessor removal, that will need escalation.

Attachment: Redline_Redwood_DPA_CareGrid_20281005.pdf — please review and confirm the signer (title + email) for the DocuSign envelope. Also attaching a lightweight evidence_matrix_caregrid.xlsx that maps SOC2/SIG items you requested.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
